frank.delta: Reuse Project Engine goal/world/checkpoint/replay continuity patterns, but place all material effects behind the current external capability/commit gateway; do not inherit unrestricted model-owned filesystem/shell authority.

harness.delta: Add bypass-negative tests: every privileged tool/effect must fail without a valid external capability grant and must emit decision/effect receipts. Add checkpoint crash/resume and replay equivalence tests.

claycode.delta: Represent effect requirements, capability scope, provenance, denial and commit receipts as semantic IR/runtime contracts rather than prompt-only policy text.

unifieddb.delta: Persist capability grants, authorization decisions, effect receipts and recovery/rollback identity independently from preferences/policies and learned agent profile state.

claygraph.delta: Project Engine world-model patterns are reusable, but graph activation/relation state must remain non-authoritative for execution.

clayresearch.delta: Classify Project Engine as mixed inheritance: continuity/observability mechanisms are reusable; sandbox removal and weak in-process policy gating are negative-result/superseded architecture evidence.

gwt.delta: Keep workspace selection/broadcast distinct from execution authorization; this shard adds architecture-control evidence, not a new GWT mechanism claim.

emergenz.delta: No emergence claim promoted. Any future autonomous-coupling metric must not use effect execution as evidence unless authority decisions are separately controlled and traced.

hyperposition.delta: No higher-order coupling claim promoted. Dynamic alternatives/codependencies remain separate from capability authority.

q12_index.delta: Preserve the design turn from sandboxed project coding agent to broad full-system autonomy and the later persistent goal/world/policy/checkpoint stack as an explicit tradeoff lineage, not a single undifferentiated success story.

next_test: Exhaustive Project-Frankenstein tool-callgraph plus deployment sandbox/capability inspection once a recursive read surface or equivalent complete manifest exists.
